answer:
Application is reactingParcelFoam in OpenFOAM.
The geometry is a 2D axisymmetric cylindrical chamber with axial length 0.2 m and diameter 0.1 m (radius 0.05 m).
The mesh is generated with blockMesh using 100 cells in the axial (x) direction and 50 cells in the radial (r) direction.
simpleGrading is set to (2 1 1 1 1 2), giving a grading ratio of 2 on the x-edge (finer at x=0, injector face) and a grading ratio of 2 on the r-edge (finer at r=0, axis). All other edges use ratio 1.
Boundary conditions on the axis (r=0) are of type axis.
Boundary conditions on the wall (r=0.05 m) are noSlip for velocity and fixedValue 400 K for temperature.
The inlet face (x=0) is a co-flow air boundary with fixedValue velocity (10 0 0) m/s, fixedValue temperature 800 K, fixedValue pressure 101325 Pa, and fixedValue mass fractions Y_O2=0.233 and Y_N2=0.767.
The outlet face (x=0.2 m) uses totalPressure for pressure and zeroGradient for all other fields.
Turbulence model is k-epsilon.
Inlet turbulence is derived from I_turb=0.05, U_ref=10 m/s, and L_t=0.007 m, yielding k_inlet=0.375 m^2/s^2 and epsilon_inlet=5.57 s^-1.
Inlet k boundary condition uses the nutk function object with the stated turbulence intensity and reference velocity.
Inlet epsilon boundary condition is fixedValue 5.57 s^-1.
Wall k boundary condition is kqRWallFunction and wall epsilon boundary condition is epsilonWallFunction.
Initial field values in the domain are U=(0 0 0), k=1e-10, epsilon=1e-10, T=800 K, p=101325 Pa, Y_O2=0.233, Y_N2=0.767, and all other species Y=0.
The spray cloud uses the cone model positioned at the inlet center point (x=0, r=0).
The injected liquid is n-dodecane (nC12H26).
The spray massFlowRate is 0.002 kg/s.
The liquid droplet temperature is 300 K.
The droplet size distribution is Rosin-Rammler with a mean diameter of 50e-6 m; the q and d0 parameters follow the OpenFOAM Rosin-Rammler defaults consistent with that mean.
The cone angle uses the OpenFOAM default value.
The heat and mass transfer model is RanzMarshall.
The drag model is standard.
The combustion model is finiteRate with thermoType janaf.
The reaction scheme is a two-step global mechanism: step 1 is C12H26 + 18.5 O2 -> 12 CO + 13 H2O, and step 2 is 2 CO + O2 -> 2 CO2.
The species list in the reaction scheme is nC12H26, O2, N2, CO, H2O, CO2.
Kinetic parameters (pre-exponential factor A, activation energy Ea, reaction enthalpy) are taken from the OpenFOAM reactingParcelFoam n-dodecane tutorial reactionSchemes file.
Liquid evaporation is handled by the RanzMarshall mass transfer model in sprayCloudProperties, not by the reaction mechanism.
The thermophysical model uses the janaf table; no constant specific heat is specified.
In system/controlDict, application is reactingParcelFoam, startFrom is startTime, startTime is 0, stopAt is endTime, endTime is 0.05, deltaT is 1e-5, adjustTimeStep is yes, maxCo is 0.7, writeControl is time, and writeInterval is 0.001.
No maxDeltaT is set.
In system/fvSolution, the configuration follows the OpenFOAM reactingParcelFoam dodecane tutorial defaults: PIMPLE with 2 outer iterations, GAMG for pressure, smoothSolver with relTol 0.1 and tolerance 1e-8 for U, T, k, epsilon, and all Y species, and residual convergence criteria at the tutorial default level.
In system/fvSchemes, the configuration follows the OpenFOAM reactingParcelFoam dodecane tutorial defaults: gradient scheme Gauss linear, div scheme Gauss linear, time scheme Euler, diffusion scheme linear, and convection scheme upwind.
